data_fields.name: fog_mask_radius
data_fields.donor_constant: header radius (value not in donor box)

best_idea: Reveal the map by stamping a fixed view mask around the player into a monotone 'ever seen' layer, and show a hostile on the minimap only once it is engaged in combat and inside the view radius.
decision_why: The stamp and the engaged-only blip are cheap and match zones as data and the hate list; the bit-subdivided tiles, two prebuilt zoom surfaces and per-frame blip list are not needed for a 3D world, and the explored state must be server-owned.
acceptance: An unexplored block stays dark on the minimap until the player's view reaches it, and a hostile appears as a red dot only after it engages the player and within the radius, disappearing when it dies or leaves; a server test asserts that the minimap payload sent to a client contains only engaged hostiles within the view radius.
